## Summary

Describe the change and link related work.

## Checks

- [ ] PR targets `development` (unless it is the owner-reviewed release PR to `main`).
- [ ] CI passes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, subscriber emails or production data.
- [ ] No invented financial/regulated claims or unauthorized branding modifications.

## Release gate

All PRs targeting `main` require manual owner review and merge. Never auto-merge them.
